name: OpenWeatherMap
tagline: Global weather data API for current conditions, forecasts, historical data, and air quality.
description: OpenWeatherMap provides weather data APIs covering current weather, multi-day forecasts, historical archives, and air pollution for locations worldwide. Developers authenticate with a free API key and call HTTPS REST endpoints that return JSON. The free tier supports basic current weather and forecast calls with daily call limits; paid plans unlock higher volume, longer history, and specialized products.

auth.details: API key via appid query parameter (also supported as header in some products); self-serve signup at openweathermap.org.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free Current Weather & Forecasts: 60 calls/minute and 1,000,000 calls/month. One Call 3.0/4.0 separately: first 1,000 calls/day free (pay-per-call after).
pricing.paid_plans: Startup, Developer, Professional, Expert, Enterprise tiers with higher limits and products.

rate_limits: Varies by plan; free tier historically ~60 calls/minute; confirm on current pricing/docs.
use_cases: get current weather for a city by name
fetch air pollution / AQI for a location
look up weather by ZIP or city ID
power weather widgets or alerts in an app
